purpose: Document first-party Numazu cadastral custody/procedure, official map review, catalog discovery, anonymous schema inspection, and bounded safe-ID geometry check.
assessment: Numazu City's official pages evidence a local cadastral-survey function and a public counter procedure for cadastral-map copies. The anonymous G-Space/Ministry of Justice extract for municipality 22203 was fetched and inspected, but the bounded exact WUP point test returned zero features; no sample was retained and runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: Local cadastral custody/procedure is evidenced by Numazu City's official cadastral-survey and cadastral-map-copy pages. This establishes an institutional local source/procedure, not admission of an anonymous citywide parcel runtime source.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official page identifies the cadastral-survey section and describes parcel-level cadastral surveying under the National Land Survey Act.
Official FAQ says any person may request a cadastral-map copy by place/lot at the city counter for a stated fee.
Official cadastral-map-copy application form; not an online parcel geometry service.
Official online urban-planning summary map; page warns it is not a legally certifying document and it was not treated as cadastral geometry.
Anonymous CKAN response lists Numazu municipality code 22203 GeoJSON/SHP resources for 2022-2026.
Anonymous GeoJSON returned HTTP 200 with CRS84, Polygon geometries, native ID field ID and 31,430 features; FeatureCollection name says 2025 although resource path/label says 2026.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Downloaded source was checked with the exact unchanged WUP point [35.1153877559585, 138.891184277782] in longitude/latitude geometry order; zero intersecting features were returned. This is not an absence/completeness test.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Published Numazu municipality registry-map extract plus official city cadastral procedure/public map pages.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Catalog/resource, schema, CRS, feature count and native ID verified; exact point returned zero; citywide and countrywide completeness not verified.

remainingUncertainty: No current official Numazu viewer configuration exposing cadastral geometry was identified; resource naming/version differs between URL/catalog and FeatureCollection name; zero exact-point hit cannot establish absence. Unsafe owner/address/lot/title/tax/personal fields were not requested or retained.
